worldLore:
'''Eight stars form a fragile network.''' The [[Solar Concord]] keeps the old charter of open passage, the [[Crucible Combine]] builds the machinery that makes it possible, and the [[Free Tide]] refuses to let either power own the frontier.

The first expedition travelled from [[Sol]] to [[Asterion]]. Foundries later spread into [[Cinder]] and [[Vesper]], while independent ports grew around [[Pelagos]] and [[Halcyon]]. Their history is recorded in the [[Settlement Chronicle]]. Freight, patrols and survey vessels share the [[Quantum Gates]], each under a different agreement.

Now the ruins of [[Reliquary]] broadcast the [[Nacre Beacon]]. A ship returning from [[Silent Reach]] has lost part of its navigation log. Three delegations share the laboratories of [[Beacon Watch]], but none agrees on what the signal means or who should control the next passage.

This is a fictional demonstration setting. [[Sol]] preserves eight real planets and selected moons with scientific descriptions; the surrounding systems, settlements and political history are invented. To explore article formatting, visit [[Wikitext Example]], [[Markdown Example]] and [[Long Article Example]].
legend: Blue — Solar Concord | Red — Crucible Combine | Green — Free Tide | Yellow — Neutral Territories

stars.name: Sol
stars.lore: '''Sol''' is the real Solar System: eight planets orbit the Sun. This atlas includes [[Mercury]], [[Venus]], [[Earth]], [[Mars]], [[Jupiter]], [[Saturn]], [[Uranus]] and [[Neptune]], with a selection of real moons. Distances, sizes and orbital speeds are schematic, not to scale. The [[Solar Concord]] and [[Exodus Station]], a fictional orbital port at [[Earth]], belong to the demonstration setting; the planetary articles describe real astronomy.

stars.name: Asterion
stars.lore: '''Asterion''' was the first settlement beyond [[Sol]]. [[Daybreak]] holds the assembly, [[Orchard]] supplies its food and [[Crown]] marks the outer approach. The [[Solar Concord]] maintains the gate, but its patrols now spend as much time negotiating passage rights as guiding civilian ships.

stars.name: Cinder
stars.lore: '''Cinder''' is the industrial heart of the [[Crucible Combine]]. [[Forge]] and [[Crucible Yard]] build ships and gate components from materials surveyed on [[Ash]]. Its direct connection to [[Sol]] keeps rival governments talking even when customs disputes threaten the network.

stars.name: Vesper
stars.lore: '''Vesper''' carries freight between the foundries of [[Cinder]] and the ports of [[Pelagos]]. [[Anvil]] makes heavy components; [[Dusk]] organizes convoys. The [[Crucible Combine]] considers this corridor indispensable, and the [[Free Tide]] refuses to grant it exclusive passage.

stars.name: Pelagos
stars.lore: '''Pelagos''' is the maritime centre of the [[Free Tide]]. Ships call at [[Thalassa]], [[Shoal]] and [[Tide Spindle]] before heading toward [[Nacre]] or the one-way survey supply run to [[Silent Reach]]. Its councils will share charts with anyone, but will not sell ownership of the route.

stars.name: Halcyon
stars.lore: '''Halcyon''' shelters the quiet worlds [[Haven]] and [[Pale]]. Rescue crews watch the approach from [[Nacre]] and maintain supplies on [[Wisp]]. The [[Free Tide]] regards this system as a refuge rather than a fortress, even as the dispute over the [[Nacre Beacon]] brings new visitors.

stars.name: Nacre
stars.lore: '''Nacre''' is a neutral system centred on [[Reliquary]] and the research outpost [[Beacon Watch]]. Its [[Nacre Beacon|unexplained signal]] has drawn representatives of all three powers. The joint survey agreement allows observation but forbids any one delegation from occupying the ruins.

stars.name: Silent Reach
stars.lore: '''Silent Reach''' is a surveyed star with no recorded planets. A supply expedition from [[Pelagos]] returned with a gap in its navigation log, leaving the system under renewed observation. The archive does not invent worlds to fill that silence: this is the map's single example of a star without planets.

satellites.name: Exodus Station
satellites.lore: '''Exodus Station''' is the orbital gateway of [[Earth]] and a major civilian port of the [[Solar Concord]]. Its rotating ring houses departure halls, hydroponic gardens and temporary quarters for expedition crews. Service docks prepare [[Jump Ships]] for journeys beyond [[Sol]], while returning explorers bring their discoveries to the station's public archive.

planets.name: Daybreak
planets.lore: '''Daybreak''' is the assembly world of the [[Solar Concord]]. Its coastal cities overlook a shallow equatorial sea. Delegates meet on [[Concord Ring]] so that no surface nation controls the chamber. The first settlers arrived from [[Sol]], as recorded in the [[Settlement Chronicle]].

satellites.name: Concord Ring
satellites.lore: '''Concord Ring''' hosts the assembly of the [[Solar Concord]] above [[Daybreak]]. A public docking hall welcomes delegations from [[Free Tide]] ports and [[Crucible Combine]] foundries. Its charter requires every arrival slot and council vote to be recorded in the open archive.

planets.name: Orchard
planets.lore: '''Orchard''' feeds the settlements of [[Asterion]]. Broad river plains support farms under the Concord's common seed charter. Cargo crews send preserved food to [[Daybreak]] and sell the surplus at [[Pelagos]]. The harvest council measures prosperity in reserve supplies rather than gate tolls.

planets.name: Crown
planets.lore: '''Crown''' is a ringed giant at the edge of [[Asterion]]'s settled orbits. Navigation crews use its rings as a calibration landmark before travelling to [[Nacre]]. Its small moon [[Mote]] carries an automated weather receiver maintained by the [[Solar Concord]].

satellites.name: Mote
satellites.lore: '''Mote''' is a small cratered moon of [[Crown]]. A remote receiver relays storm measurements to the navigators of [[Asterion]]. No permanent crew lives here; service ships visit between scheduled departures through the [[Quantum Gates]].

planets.name: Forge
planets.lore: '''Forge''' houses the foundries of the [[Crucible Combine]]. Iron-coloured plateaus surround deep industrial basins, while [[Crucible Yard]] keeps the largest hulls away from the surface. The directorate claims that its gate tolls pay for the machinery on which every other faction depends.

satellites.name: Crucible Yard
satellites.lore: '''Crucible Yard''' assembles [[Jump Ships]] above [[Forge]]. Its docks also wind the field coils used in a [[Gate Drive]]. The [[Crucible Combine]] guards the manufacturing records, but civilian repair crews may lease a berth when military contracts leave room.

planets.name: Ash
planets.lore: '''Ash''' is a dry, wind-scoured world in [[Cinder]]. Survey crews work beneath sealed shelters and send mineral samples to [[Forge]]. Long abandoned prospecting trails remind visitors that the Combine's industrial wealth began with small expeditions and uncertain claims.

planets.name: Dusk
planets.lore: '''Dusk''' is the convoy port of [[Vesper]]. Its dim blue seas reflect a sky veiled with dust. Crews gather here before the supply crossing to [[Pelagos]], carrying replacement gate parts and returning with food. Combine inspectors check every departure against a signed cargo contract.

planets.name: Anvil
planets.lore: '''Anvil''' produces the heavy components shipped from [[Vesper]] to [[Cinder]]. Excavation belts cut through its dark rocky plains. The [[Crucible Combine]] operates the mines through rotating crews, who spend their leave on [[Dusk]] rather than in Anvil's sealed surface settlements.

planets.name: Thalassa
planets.lore: '''Thalassa''' is an ocean world of the [[Free Tide]]. Floating cities follow sheltered current systems, trading with the docking crews of [[Tide Spindle]]. Its port councils oppose permanent borders on the water and exclusive concessions on the [[Quantum Gates]]. Life here is fictional; [[Europa]] describes a real moon with a possible subsurface ocean.

satellites.name: Tide Spindle
satellites.lore: '''Tide Spindle''' turns above [[Thalassa]], balancing workshops along a narrow rotating hull. It provides repairs, medical aid and meeting rooms to [[Free Tide]] crews. Engineers here are examining the navigation log returned from [[Silent Reach]] and comparing it with recordings of the [[Nacre Beacon]].

planets.name: Shoal
planets.lore: '''Shoal''' offers quiet harbours and low-gravity repair basins in [[Pelagos]]. Small independent yards rebuild survey vessels that cannot afford Combine docks. The port council keeps a reserve of spare navigation clocks after the unexplained voyage to [[Silent Reach]].

planets.name: Haven
planets.lore: '''Haven''' shelters rescue crews and migrant families in [[Halcyon]]. Its wooded continents support modest settlements connected by public landing fields. Volunteers watch the trade approaches and keep emergency supplies on the moon [[Wisp]]. The [[Free Tide]] regards rescue as a duty that carries no political debt.

satellites.name: Wisp
satellites.lore: '''Wisp''' circles [[Haven]] with little more than an automated landing beacon and a buried store of emergency supplies. Volunteer crews replenish the cache before the storm season. The moon demonstrates an uninhabited satellite with a practical place in the [[Free Tide]]'s rescue network.

planets.name: Pale
planets.lore: '''Pale''' is an icy world beyond [[Haven]]. Seasonal crews map its fractured plains and collect frozen samples for the laboratories at [[Beacon Watch]]. Visits are short, and the rescue service of [[Halcyon]] requires every expedition to leave a return plan before departure.

planets.name: Reliquary
planets.lore: '''Reliquary''' is the only charted planet of [[Nacre]]. Pale ridges surround a basin of ruins that predates the first human survey. Receivers near the excavation detect the [[Nacre Beacon]], but researchers have not found its transmitter. [[Beacon Watch]] operates under a joint agreement between the three powers.

satellites.name: Beacon Watch
satellites.lore: '''Beacon Watch''' is a compact research outpost above [[Reliquary]]. Observers from the [[Solar Concord]], [[Crucible Combine]] and [[Free Tide]] share its cramped laboratories. All raw recordings of the [[Nacre Beacon]] enter a public archive before any delegation can claim a discovery.

planets.name: Alderamin
planets.lore: A lonely planet in the middle of nowhere
